commitMessage:
Device form: GPS clock time zone (decoder.timezone) with radio buttons

Some trackers have no time zone setting and send local time, so every
position is 7 hours ahead. The device form gets a 'Jam GPS' section with
radio buttons for UTC (default, attribute removed), WIB, WITA and WIT,
stored as the standard Traccar device attribute 'decoder.timezone' that
the server applies when decoding (e.g. GT06 reads it at device login, so
it takes effect after the device reconnects). When the last position's
fix time is 7/8/9 hours ahead of the server time and nothing is set, a
suggestion with a 'Pakai' button appears. Docs updated.
